accessibility.reducedMotion: Suppress animation and transition; preserve immediate end state.

administration.world: Existing neutral RTL surfaces, Assistant labels, Inter tabular figures and flat hairline rows.
administration.structure: Compact header; four metrics; 14-day paired bars and service states; searchable 25-row customer pages; closed password disclosure.
administration.headerAccessibility: Accessible control labels persist at mobile widths. Logout retains aria-label and title of יציאה when visible text is hidden; the browser scenario logs out after resizing to 320px.
administration.responsive: 1120px main maximum; chart/services stack below 960px; 2 by 2 metrics and activity below identity below 600px; wrapped names/emails at 320px.

chart.interaction: Actual daily counts on hover or visible keyboard focus, with accessible labels and inward anchoring for the first and last four tooltips.

administration.dataTruth: Customer metrics use role=user. Latest authenticated request activity is throttled 10 minutes, with historical session-creation backfill. Service configuration and stale-heartbeat states do not claim delivery or uptime.
administration.access: Each cross-account query verifies current database role=admin. Dedicated accounts redirect to /admin; provisioning uses a separate operator-only script.
administration.privacy: No private task content, phone numbers, credentials/tokens or raw provider errors.

resetAction.label: איפוס סיסמה
resetAction.placement: Compact underlined action beneath each customer identity, with a 44px target and an accessible name containing the stored recipient email.
resetAction.feedback: Wrapping sent, error and truthful local preview states; pending and resend cooldown disable repeat requests.
resetAction.access: Verify current database role=admin before any target/email lookup; accept only role=user recipients and their stored email. The administrator receives no token and chooses no password.
resetAction.privacy: Recovery URLs are excluded from visitor analytics.
resetAction.recovery: Existing one-hour single-use recovery changes password and sessions only upon recipient completion. Concurrent issuance enforces at least 60 seconds between requests and at most three live tokens; the public response remains unchanged.
resetAction.review: Local ship verdict in .impeccable/review/admin-reset-review.md, with desktop/mobile/narrow/dark/feedback captures and 44px, overflow and privacy checks. Reported execution: nine new backend tests, six existing mail tests and ten targeted browser scenarios; deployment and live email delivery require separate evidence.

review.scope: Local surface with synthetic customers in a separate database; 1440px, 390px, 320px and desktop dark captures.
review.reportedChecks: 352 unit tests, 98 browser scenarios and meaningful local search/password/pagination checks; not rerun by documenter.
review.liveChecks: Production deployment and administrator creation require separate live checks.

provenance.authority: User-pinned Todoist canon; code-led replacement after explicit rejection.
provenance.reviewScope: Authenticated replacement and two scored fixes; production deployment and public landing are not certified by this documentation.
provenance.shippingRasters: No new raster in this code-led replacement. Existing blue identity and WhatsApp illustration/provenance are preserved.

narrative.northStar: A clear place for Hebrew work
narrative.overview:
A clear Hebrew task canvas follows the operating grammar the user pinned from Todoist: white work, pale gray navigation, short sans headings, flat rows and round completion controls. The app is quiet at rest. Tasks carry the reading weight; navigation and attributes explain place and state without becoming the main content.

This records the implemented replacement of 2026-10-04. The user rejected the lavender ground, dark indigo rail, large serif date, progress rail, crowded permanent filters and supporting cards on Today. The app uses Assistant throughout its working hierarchy, including its current live rail wordmark. Frank Ruhl Libre remains the public editorial face; the existing blue identity image remains an identity asset rather than the action accent.

The authority is the user-pinned, code-led Todoist canon in design/todoist-research.md, not assigned candidate 5. Its recorded seed is 95c8c208, also emitted by src/app/layout.tsx. The signed-out public landing retains its independent editorial composition and is outside this replacement finish review. Shared global tokens apply there, but app composition rules do not turn its headings into the authenticated hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: A neutral task canvas, flat rows and brief metadata.
Hebrew sans hierarchy, normal letter spacing and isolated tabular numerals.
Controls on demand, with active conditions explained in the working view.
Four mobile destinations and a separate capture action.
Completion is the main feedback moment; reduced motion is immediate.

rules.name: Neutral Ground
rules.body: Accent choice may change actions and selected-state washes; it must not tint the work canvas, base navigation, text ramp or dividers.

rules.name: Stable Meaning
rules.body: Keep action, priority, deadline and project tokens separate. Default action red and urgency red coexist; text, icons and accessible labels explain their different meanings.

rules.name: Hebrew Reading
rules.body: Use Assistant for app headings and controls, normal Hebrew letter spacing, and isolated LTR islands for times, dates, shortcuts and counts. User-entered free text resolves with dir="auto".

rules.name: Flat Work
rules.body: Task rows stay flat at rest. Elevation identifies an overlay, capture surface or item being dragged; it does not turn the task collection into a deck of cards.

dos: Do use semantic CSS tokens and preserve their canonical light-dark() / OKLCH values.
Do keep task titles readable at 16px and keep supporting metadata subordinate.
Do make every active search, priority and sort condition visible after Display closes, with a reset action.
Do preserve separate schedule and deadline semantics in every view.
Do keep touch targets generous without enlarging the task glyphs or creating horizontal page overflow.
Do retain keyboard access, accessible control names and immediate reduced-motion end states.
Do preserve the public landing editorial role and image provenance when touching shared styles.
donts: Don't restore the rejected lavender ground, dark accent rail, serif Today date, progress rail, permanent Today filter form or Today insight cards.
Don't make Add a fifth mobile destination or duplicate the mobile navigation toolbar.
Don't repeat Today as metadata on every Today task; show its scheduled time when present.
Don't use a swatch or red alone to communicate priority, lateness, an error or destructive intent.
Don't replace real task, collaboration or service state with fabricated customer content or delivery proof.
Don't treat the scoped fix verdict, local captures or documentation as proof of production deployment or the unreviewed landing.
